text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed inconsistent exception shapes between python/js SDKs for auth failures. In Python we raise InvalidTokenError with .reason and .code, JS just surfaces a 401 response text 'Unauthorized' (no typed error). This breaks customer retry/mapping logic and the sample apps. cc @devex

alex: Ugh yeah. We should define a cross-SDK error contract. Minimal fields: name, code, status, retryable, message, metadata. That will let customers reliably implement retry/wrap logic.

jia: Also important: error messages sometimes leak internal IDs (token ids). We need a rule to scrub PII from messages and push sensitive metadata into non-user-visible fields.

sam: Agreed. Quick proposal for mapping table (HTTP -> SDK error):
```
200-299 -> success
400 -> ValidationError (code: invalid_input, retryable: false)
401 -> AuthError (code: auth_invalid, retryable: false)
403 -> PermissionError (code: forbidden, retryable: false)
429 -> RateLimitError (code: rate_limited, retryable: true, retry_after header)
500-599 -> ServerError (code: server_error, retryable: true)
```
This also preserves status for observability.

kevin: I've started a small PR that adds a common Error base class in python and a typed Error in JS that implements the fields above. Draft link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/88 (WIP). Also added a test harness to ensure marshalling parity.

maria: Nice. Can we also standardize error.codes? e.g., auth_invalid, rate_limited, model_unavailable, quota_exceeded. If codes are stable, teams can build deterministic fallbacks.

alex: +1. We'll add a doc page "SDK error contract" in devex docs, and include a migration snippet for existing customers. Example client-side retry wrapper using the retryable flag:
```js
async function callWithRetry(fn, retries = 3) {
  for (let i = 0; i < retries; i++) {
    try {
      return await fn();
    } catch (err) {
      if (!err.retryable) throw err;
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.pow(2, i) * 100));
    }
  }
}
```

jia: Also add guidance for SDKs to attach minimal metadata (request_id, region, model) to error.metadata for debugging without exposing sensitive bits. And ensure errors are JSON-serializable for logs.

devex-bot: Ticket created: DEVEX-452 "SDK error contract + parity + docs" assigned to alex, kevin

kevin: I'll expand the PR to include mapping tests across python/node/go and add sample quickstart snippets. Planning to land before next sprint.

maria: Thanks — please make sure to update the quickstart sample apps so onboarding friction is minimized (we often see users fail because they expect a typed error and end up parsing response.status). Add a short migration note: "if you relied on response.status, switch to error.code and error.retryable".

alex: Will do. I'll also add a small lint rule in SDK CI to prevent accidental plaintext token echoes in error messages.

maria: Assigning follow-ups: alex (spec + docs), kevin (SDK parity PR + tests), jia (PII guidance). Ping me if blockers. :thumbsup:

sam: One more thought — consider adding an opt-in compatibility flag for a release cycle where SDKs emit both old and new shapes to ease migration.

maria: Smart idea. Let's discuss timeline in tomorrow sync.

kevin: Quick note — for older customers on pinned versions we'll provide a changelog and a migration helper script in the repo.

maria: Great. Closing thread for now; follow-ups in DEVEX-452. Thanks everyone! :party:
